description: NERC Reliability Coordinators is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. NERC is an international regulatory authority that works to improve the reliability of the bulk power system in North America. NERC works with many different regional entities to improve the coordination and supply of electricity. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are electricity, energy infrastructure, NERC Reliability Coordinators, emergency response. The portal shows 2025-07-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open.
